info.title: Superflow API
info.description: Read, filter, search, update, resolve, reply to and bulk-edit Superflow comments. Authenticate with a Superflow API key (sf_pat_) or an OAuth access token (sf_at_). Rate limit: 600 requests per minute per key.

bearer.description: sf_pat_ personal access token or sf_at_ OAuth access token.

anyOf.description: Per-project comment number. Null on the first calls for a project the API never numbered (numbering is best effort on reads).

text.description: First message, plain text, cut to 160 characters

priority.description: Read from the stored priority: P0 critical, P1 high, P2 medium; a stored P3 or "low" reads as low; anything else none.

url.description: Deep link that opens the thread

priority.description: Read from the stored priority: P0 critical, P1 high, P2 medium; a stored P3 or "low" reads as low; anything else none.

already_in_state.description: Selected comments already in the target state (skipped).

unchanged.description: Selected comments already in the target state (skipped, no note posted).

filter_project.name: project
filter_project.description: Projects: prj_ id, raw id, name, site URL or domain. Omit for every project. Comma separated, or repeated.

filter_page_url.name: page_url
filter_page_url.description: An absolute page URL, or a path (/blog) compared against the page path and query. Normalized: host lowercased, path and query case-sensitive, no fragment, no trailing slash, no toolbar params.

filter_status.name: status
filter_status.description: Status names or ids, or the words open and resolved. Comma separated, or repeated.

items.description: Read from the stored priority: P0 critical, P1 high, P2 medium; a stored P3 or "low" reads as low; anything else none.

filter_assignee.name: assignee
filter_assignee.description: People (id, email, name), me, or unassigned. Comma separated, or repeated.

filter_author.name: author
filter_author.description: People (id, email, name), or me. Comma separated, or repeated.

filter_author_type.name: author_type
filter_author_type.description: Author types. Comma separated, or repeated.

filter_tags.name: tags
filter_tags.description: Tag names or tag_ ids. Comma separated, or repeated.

filter_query.name: query
filter_query.description: Case-insensitive text search over every message.

filter_created_after.name: created_after
filter_created_after.description: ISO 8601, or 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week (UTC).

filter_created_before.name: created_before
filter_created_before.description: ISO 8601, or 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week (UTC).

filter_updated_after.name: updated_after
filter_updated_after.description: ISO 8601, or 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week (UTC).

filter_updated_before.name: updated_before
filter_updated_before.description: ISO 8601, or 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week (UTC).

filter_resolved_after.name: resolved_after
filter_resolved_after.description: Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is after this date.

filter_resolved_before.name: resolved_before
filter_resolved_before.description: Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is before this date.

filter_unanswered.name: unanswered
filter_unanswered.description: Last message is from a guest or an agent and no member replied after it.

filter_stale_days.name: stale_days
filter_stale_days.description: Not resolved and no activity for N days.

Invalid.description: invalid (400), or a wrong method (405 with Allow)
